title: When My AI Team
<g>Clocks In</g>
subtitle: Six timers, one day. Each one switches on once its room passes its tests.

cards.title: The watchdog checks
cards.body: Did every timer run? Did anything run twice or overspend?

cards.title: Growth plans the week
cards.body: Drafts the week's content, ready for my yes.

cards.title: Operations does a round
cards.body: Picks up new work and drafts what's due.

cards.title: The runner ticks
cards.body: Hands each new event to the rooms that care.

cards.title: It learns from today
cards.body: Every yes, edit and no becomes an example.

cards.title: It proposes an upgrade
cards.body: One change to a playbook, for me to accept.
